name: Honeycombe-on-the-Wold
tagline: A honey-stone village in a green fold of the Wolds.
opening: Help Honeycombe look its best before the village judges arrive.

intro.title: A new assignment
intro.body:
Dear Photographer,

Welcome to the Wold & Vale Postcard Company! Your first assignment is Honeycombe-on-the-Wold, which has entered the county's Best-Kept Village competition.

The village is lovely, but it has let itself go a little. The villagers will show you what needs doing, place by place. Help them put it right, and send us a postcard of every corner you restore.

The train gets in at eleven. Mr Figg, the stationmaster, will meet you.

Yours, with great expectations,
Clementine Ashby
Editor

welcome.title: Welcome to Honeycombe!
welcome.body:
Ah, the photographer! Capital. Colonel Whitby, chair of the Best-Kept Village Committee.

The judges arrive in the spring and, between ourselves, the place is a shambles. Litter on the platform, paint peeling on the High Street, and the Green not fit to be seen.

Mr Figg has you at the Halt first. After that, every villager in Honeycombe has a job for you. We'll get there, you'll see.

teaser.title: A postcard from Cornwall
teaser.body:
Letter for you, sorry it's late. Postmark says Porthkennack Cove. Picture of a harbour on the front. Lovely, isn't it?

Someone there's heard about your postcards, I reckon.

finale.title: Your next assignment
finale.body:
Dear Photographer,

Best-Kept Village! The whole company is thrilled, and the Honeycombe postcards are our best-sellers of the year.

Word travels. Porthkennack Cove in Cornwall has entered the Coastal Village Prize, and they're already asking for you by name. We're still making the arrangements, so there's no ticket yet; I'll write the moment there is.

Until then, enjoy Honeycombe. You've earned it.

Yours, very proudly,
Clementine Ashby
